entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana, I'm calling about an order I received a few weeks ago. I need to make a return.
I can certainly look into that for you. To start, could I get your name and order number? And just to be clear, what specifically is the issue with the item?
Sure, the name is Alex Smith, order number is VF789012. It's about a cycling jersey I bought. I tried it on, and it's the wrong size.
Okay, Alex, I see the order here. So is it a preference issue, for example, the jersey is just a bit too tight, or is there a defect with the sizing label?
No defect, it's just much too tight for me. I definitely need a larger size. I'd like to do an exchange if possible.

Understood. Let me just pull up our current policy. Okay, I see your delivery was 20 days ago. Since the jersey is a standard apparel item, it falls within our 90-day return window. So yes, we can absolutely process an exchange for you.
That's great to hear. What's the process?

I'm emailing you a pre-paid return label right now. Just package the jersey, attach the label, and drop it at any post office. Once we receive it, we'll ship out the new size you requested. It's that simple.

Okay, that works. I appreciate you making it easy. Now, since I do have to go through the trouble of repackaging this and running to the post office, would it be possible to get a small discount code for a future purchase? Maybe 10% for the inconvenience?

I understand your request, Alex. While we cover the full cost of the return shipping for the exchange, our policy doesn't allow for additional credits or discounts for sizing issues. We provide detailed sizing charts on the product page to help avoid this.
Fair enough, I had to ask. The free shipping label is helpful. I'll get that sent back this week. Thanks for your help, Diana.
You're very welcome, Alex. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day!
